name: Farewell
summary: A delete-account danger zone with type-to-confirm, live progress and a card that blows away as dust
about: Farewell is a full delete-account flow for settings pages. The danger zone opens to list what will be lost and asks you to type the account name, checking every letter as you go; only an exact match unlocks the Delete forever button. Orders, products and invoices then count down to zero, the whole card blows away as dust from left to right, and a calm goodbye card offers Restore account, which pulls the dust back together.
how: Press Delete account… in the danger zone; it opens with a list of what will be lost.
Type ayesha-traders: right letters turn red, a wrong one shakes the field and is marked; the padlock opens on an exact match.
Press Delete forever (or Enter): each count runs down to zero with its own bar.
The card blows away as dust and the goodbye card sails in.
Press Restore account and the dust flies back into place; Cancel or Esc closes the danger zone.
